title: Scorpio, your depth is an invitation
caption: you're going to read this one twice

scenes.text: scorpio, you're already reading between these lines.
mars and pluto made you for deep water.
you skip small talk and wait for the hour it gets real.
they get your first name. you get their whole story.
it isn't cold. it's how you keep the soft things safe.
but a locked door keeps out the ones who'd stay, too.
and when it ends, you leave a window open to watch.
you've burned down before. you always come back.
so let this one burn clean. release it. don't haunt it.
someone good won't pry. they'll knock, and wait.
let them read your sky long before they see your face.
your depth was never a warning. it's an invitation.
rest now. the deep will keep until morning.
